animations.notes: React has no built-in animation engine. framer-motion, react-spring, and GSAP are common. Detect per-site.

quirks.description: Plain React apps are full SPAs with no server-side rendering. Content is only available after JavaScript executes.
quirks.workaround: Wait for network idle + DOM stable before extracting. Content renders client-side only.

quirks.description: Direct URL navigation may show a loading spinner or skeleton instead of actual content.
quirks.workaround: Wait for content render after navigation. Check for known loading indicators disappearing before extraction.

quirks.description: React apps use arbitrary container IDs (#root, #app, #todoist_app, etc.), not just #root. Detection must not depend on a specific container ID.
quirks.workaround: Use fiber-based detection (__reactFiber$*, __reactContainer$*) which works regardless of container ID.

quirks.description: Detection must exclude Next.js (both routers), Gatsby, Remix, and React Router v7 framework mode which are all React-based but have their own adapters.
React 18+ createRoot() does NOT set _reactRootContainer on the container element. It uses __reactContainer$* instead.
quirks.workaround: Use __reactContainer$* prefix matching for modern React, _reactRootContainer for legacy.

quirks.description: The $randomSuffix on __reactFiber$* and __reactContainer$* changes on every page load. Detection must use prefix matching (startsWith).
quirks.workaround: Never match exact property names. Always use Object.keys().some(k => k.startsWith('__reactFiber$')).

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
